ns2:course.label: Intermediate Graphic Design II
ns2:course.description: This intermediate studio tasks student teams analyze a system of designed products or services and propose/manage an intervention strategy. Students develop inclusive practices with stakeholders, who are addressed with empathy as co-creators. This topic studio changes in content with each semester. Prerequisite: Junior standing in graphic design curriculum and ARTD 310.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Junior standing in graphic design curriculum and ARTD 310.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: A student registered in one or more Art & Design course(s) exhibiting this message, will be assessed a $95 facility use fee once each term.
